outcome_evidence: At frame 0, image and left_ego_image show the oven door lowered and open. The robot approaches the door and raises it through frames 54–68, bringing it upright against the oven front. Frames 128–143 in left_ego_image show the door remaining upright in the closed position as the gripper withdraws; wrist_image also shows the raised door beside the gripper. No failed acquisition, harmful collision, or displacement of unrelated objects is visibly established.
